pages.title: Where to find
pages.text: Look for the encounter at: Ancient Factory.

pages.title: How to fight
pages.text: In singleplayer, use a Nether Star on the inactive Harbinger in the Ancient Factory; one star is consumed. On a dedicated host this native interaction does not replace canonical Start. Bring a melee weapon: a bow alone is not sufficient for the whole fight.

pages.title: What does not work
pages.text: It marks the site on your map; the locator itself does not begin combat. On a dedicated host this native interaction does not replace canonical Start. At half health or below, the Harbinger rejects hits whose direct entity is an AbstractArrow, including ordinary arrows. This conditional arrow protection does not establish immunity to every ranged attack. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.

pages.title: Drops
pages.text: Native loot for this encounter includes: Block of Witherite, Music Disc. Inspect the obtained item’s uses in JEI to choose your next equipment. Possessing an item does not replace a recorded victory. In an active campaign this main-boss victory is linked to the Lost Eye. Reading the handbook does not grant an Eye or record a victory.
